display_name: LoRa 原生 8,192 点信道修正方向消融（Full）
description: The two matched continuations split normalized center-aperture edit error into signed parallel gain and orthogonal error for generic pure additive examples. Only the orthogonal weight differs. Both arms enter formal Full after freeze.
authorization: Active LoRa native raw performance goal, frozen E104 training loss and high-confidence source clean U_s pseudo-label authorization.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

permissions.claim_scope: Authorized L_s and U_s source IQ only. Legal L_s TX CE, frozen E104 clean U_s pseudo-CE at confidence .95; U_s TX labels unavailable. Paired waveform direction losses only on generic additive source waveform pairs. No exact channel/noise arrays, target IQ, truth or V used in fitting. Both predeclared arms tested once.

checkpoint.initialization: Both load the identical immutable 313796-parameter native E104 18k source parent; restart AdamW. No architectural or E104 changes.

sources.role: Same raw observation contract and pretarget source-qualified initialization. Recursively verify formal archival parent.
Same-contract G initialization and archived Full comparison.
Frozen source training teacher and evaluation default head.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: The native parent passed a declared source rule before deployment. Target results never select fitting, hyperparameters, thresholds or retry.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 20000 continuations. Both enter Full for all seven views regardless of source accuracy. Source V is reference only. Target performance requires at least 162000/180000, 25500/30000 and 28566/30000 for practical six, low urban and clean respectively.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 [0,7,2,6,3], min 12 GiB actual free and fewer than 8 contexts, at most two workers and one per card.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on illegal provenance/roles, missing CE or orthogonal gradients, nonfinite loss, failed freeze, or incomplete/invalid exact matched Full predictions. Optional source-reference failure is recorded and does not block formal prediction.

notes: Both arms reuse unchanged fixed E104 true and pseudo-label losses, raw waveform and spectral losses, and clean consistency. No additional parameters at inference.

For an additive source pair, E is the predicted edit and D is clean minus observed. The signed real projection gain is a=<E,D>/mean(abs(D)^2). We fit .5 normalized abs((a-1)D)^2 plus .5 or 1.5 normalized abs(E-aD)^2.
Only generic pure additive cases at -8 to 4 dB contribute added edit terms, with equal source draws and perturbations in both arms. No registered practical scene settings are used in fitting.
The fixed matrix is clean plus six registered Full practical views, all 15 unseen receivers and 30000 matched physical packages for each arm. 300 held-out source packets are reported as reference.
